title: Portfolio Night
summary: Bring a draft portfolio and get feedback from peers and local professionals.
details:
## About Portfolio Night
Bring a draft portfolio, selected work, or presentation boards and get feedback in a relaxed review setting. The goal is to help students strengthen how they communicate their design process and prepare work for internships, scholarships, reviews, and future applications.

## What to bring
- A digital or printed portfolio draft
- Projects or spreads you want feedback on
- Questions about layout, storytelling, or presentation

Students are welcome even if their portfolio is still early in development.

title: Memphis Firm Crawl
summary: A sample chapter event visiting architecture and design offices around Memphis.
details:
## About the Firm Crawl
Spend an afternoon visiting architecture and design offices around Memphis. The event is intended to give students a closer look at professional practice, workplace culture, project types, and career paths available locally.

## What to expect
- Office and studio tours
- Conversations with architects and designers
- Questions about internships and early-career roles
- Opportunities to connect with local professionals

Final participating firms, meeting instructions, and transportation details can be added here as they are confirmed.

title: AIAS Chapter Meeting
summary: Monthly chapter updates, upcoming opportunities, committee work, and open discussion.
details:
## Monthly chapter meeting
Join the chapter for updates on upcoming programming, professional opportunities, committees, and current initiatives. Meetings are also a place for members to bring ideas forward and help shape what the chapter does next.

## Agenda
- Chapter announcements
- Upcoming events and deadlines
- Committee and project updates
- Open discussion and member ideas

Students interested in getting more involved are encouraged to attend.

A casual chapter social with snacks, movies, karaoke, and time to hang out outside the studio.
